meta.provenance_note: Every English field is copied from the two-page 'Contents' scope-and-sequence spread printed on pages 4-5 of the student book — the columns are UNIT, GRAMMAR, VOCABULARY, READING, LISTENING, SPEAKING, WRITING, and each entry keeps the book's own page references. Arabic titles and topic labels are OUR OWN TRANSLATIONS: this book is English-only and prints no Arabic beyond its cover, exactly as the four vocational English catalogs record for the same reason. Each unit is represented as ONE lesson at scope-and-sequence depth, matching those catalogs. That is deliberate and not a shortcut — the book prints seven lesson slots per unit (LESSON 1A..7A) but names them only by skill banner, and two of them share a page in unit 5, so a seven-lesson breakdown could not be derived without guessing which slot a page belongs to. See known_gaps.

source_books.student_book_s1: كتاب الطالب لمادة اللغة الإنجليزية الصف العاشر الفصل الأول.pdf — 78 pages, sourceId eng-s1-student-book. Contents spread: pages 4-5.

known_gaps: One lesson per unit, at scope-and-sequence depth. The book prints seven lesson slots per unit (LESSON 1A..7A at 18pt in the page header) but gives them no titles — only a skill banner (VOCABULARY, GRAMMAR, READING AND VOCABULARY, ...) whose order varies between units. In unit 5 two slots share page 52 with competing banners, so slot-to-page assignment cannot be derived from the PDF without judgement. A seven-lesson breakdown needs the teacher's guide, which is not in the repo.

No learning outcomes (نتاجات التعلم). This book prints none — unlike the science student books, whose lesson openers state them explicitly. objectives[] is therefore empty rather than invented, and this subject will report as having no official outcomes in `verify --gaps`.
No period counts. The teacher's guide, which is where the science books' periods come from, is not in the repo for English.

The LIFE SKILLS spreads (after units 2 and 4) and the end matter — Culture Spot pp58-59, Literature Spot pp60-61, Word List pp62-66, Grammar Reference pp67-71, Irregular Verbs p72, Communication pp73-75 — are recorded on the units they follow but are not modelled as lessons of their own.
